why: Items about neighbouring space mix settling border/space deals (T3-010) with alarms that a neighbour is invading (T3-005), and the two are easy to read into the same room-neighbour passages.

why.T3-026: The plurality of concepts announce or show the room's Tachanka emblem as present on the canvas (has appeared, logo on /r/place, the Lord has reached r/place, a bigger icon), which is announcing the mark is up rather than building, defending or explaining the event.

why.T3-009: Most concepts mark the shared achievement as done ('We did it', 'we have our own section', 'Chanka has taken his rightful spot. Well done', pride in participating), celebrating the finished work, with the thanks to helpers carried along by the celebrating.

why.T3-017: The concepts are the sub's usual subject talk about its operators (requests to draw Smoke/Thatcher/Jager, praise of the art, Fuze-is-a-robot and Thatcher-mustache jokes, a character-appearance argument), ordinary community business rather than canvas work or a staged April Fools fake.

why.T3-005: The single concept is an alarm that the room's Red vs Blue and Halo section is under attack, i.e. an attack on the room's work and a call to defend it.

why.T3-070: The concepts locate the shared writing and give placers what they need to reproduce it — its coordinates (888,485), a reference shot of how it should look, a request for that reference — directions shared for the writing rather than a call for hands or an explanation of the event.

why.T3-002: The surviving call 'IT'S OUR TURN BOYS' is a call to the room to make its placement, the last-attempt rally, rather than a border, defence or end-marking act.

why.T3-095: The clip is introduced as an April Fools mishap and members work out what the frames prove (counts of hits, screenshots of near misses, Epi and Ubi confirmations), testing an April-Fools-framed claim they did not stage.

why.T3-010: The room interprets its neighbours (Bluecorner, r/udub, OSRS, rainbow road) and negotiates space and shared images with them (deals for blue to surround the logo, agreeing the image can be shared, suggesting a compromise), settling lines and space with neighbours rather than a single attack being fought off.

why.T3-009: The first concept marks the shared picture complete ('We did it!') and thanks r/Halo, celebrating the finished work; the second only spots a neighbour (Funhaus) in the result.

why.T3-010: The concepts settle coexistence around the writing — a move request relayed, a good border offered, protection agreements listed, an alliance accepted — lines and shared space agreed with neighbours.

why.T3-070: As at position 6, the concepts locate the shared writing and supply the reference for reproducing it — its coordinates (888,485) and a reference shot of how it should look — directions shared for the writing, not a call for hands.

why.T3-031: Both concepts play the room's own running jokes in the canvas talk — reading the taunt backwards and owning the mistake, correcting pink to 'lightish red' — the room's familiar Red-vs-Blue humour rather than a taunt aimed at a rival.

why.T3-117: The plurality of concepts register the end of the event itself ('/r/place is over', 'r/place is closed now', 'you can no longer place pixels, the event has ended', glad it is over), marking the canvas's end with the retrospective that follows.
